title: Evidential drone localization with conformal calibration: model weights and per-sample results
description: Weights of the 16 evidential models (external-prior loss, final grid, seed 12321) and the Base Model, their conformal calibration factors, and per-sample predictions on the clean, AWGN and clutter test sets, for Variance-Aware Conformal Calibration for Evidential Acoustic Drone Localization. Source recordings: Safavi et al., DDL, IEEE MLSP 2025. See README.md.
notes: Supplementary material for: Variance-Aware Conformal Calibration for Evidential Acoustic Drone Localization.
references: Safavi, S., Çaylı, Ö., Safavi, M. A., Cook, B., & Wang, W. (2025). DDL: A dataset for drone detection and localization from multi-channel audio and a deep uncertainty-aware framework. In 2025 IEEE 35th International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP), pp. 1-6. IEEE.
